title: THE OVERSEER IS DRAWN TO ITS SIZE
why: THE OVERSEER is a warden with half again the body (44 across its feet, a warden is 30), but it was drawn exactly like a plain warden, so it looked like any other one, in both windows. It is now drawn scaled up around where it stands. Its size already rides the word the second window gets when it comes up, so both windows show it big.
now: THE OVERSEER now looks the part: it is drawn about half again as big as a plain warden, in both windows of a party.

edits.replacement: else if(e2.kind==='warden') drawWardenAt(e2);   // v16.xx: the boss is drawn to its size
